name: csharp.fix_view_visibility
description: Apply the fix for a category not being visible in the active view: turn the category on in V/G overrides and switch the view discipline to Coordination if the category is MEP (Ducts, Pipes, Cable, Conduit). Pairs with csharp.diagnose_visibility — call this AFTER diagnose_visibility identifies the cause, when the user says 'fix it', 'apply the fix', or similar.
